jobs.title: Enrollment & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Can’t Be Stopped Position: Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator

Job Type: Part\-Time

Location: Los Angeles/South Bay Area Schedule: Flexible, approximately 8–12 hours per week

Compensation: $18–$20/hour \+ enrollment commissions and performance bonuses

ABOUT CBS DANCE COMPANY

CBS Dance Company is a youth competitive dance program dedicated to providing affordable opportunities for young dancers while building confidence, discipline, teamwork and community. As we continue growing our 10th season, we're looking for an energetic and motivated person to help us increase our visibility throughout the community and introduce more families to CBS Dance Company.

THE ROLE We're looking for someone who understands both DANCE and SALES/MARKETING.

Our ideal candidate knows how to connect with parents, dancers, schools and community organizations while turning interest in our program into actual enrollments. This isn't just about posting on social media. We're looking for someone who can actively help grow the CBS Dance Company brand and our enrollment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Promote CBS Dance Company throughout the Los Angeles/South Bay community

Generate new leads and potential dancer enrollments

Follow up with parents who inquire about classes, free trials and enrollment

Help convert inquiries and trial dancers into registered CBS dancers

Develop relationships with schools, youth organizations, community centers and local businesses

Identify community events and opportunities where CBS can promote the program

Assist with social media marketing and promotional campaigns

Distribute and coordinate digital and physical promotional materials

Help create new ideas for increasing brand awareness and enrollment

Track leads, follow\-ups, trials and completed registrations

Represent CBS Dance Company professionally within the community

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR The ideal candidate: **Has a background in dance, cheer, performing arts or youth programs**  Has experience in sales, marketing, customer service or enrollment

**Is outgoing and comfortable talking with parents and potential dancers** 

Is comfortable following up with leads and asking for the enrollment

**Understands social media and grassroots/community marketing** 

Is self\-motivated and doesn't need constant supervision

**Has strong communication and organizational skills** 

Is creative and willing to bring new marketing ideas to the table

**Understands the importance of building relationships within the community** 

Is passionate about helping youth programs grow

Previous dance studio sales or enrollment experience is a PLUS!

COMPENSATION $18–$20/hour based on experience PLUS: Commission for each new dancer enrolled

Additional performance bonuses for reaching monthly enrollment goals

This position has the opportunity to grow as CBS Dance Company grows.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE:

More families knowing who CBS Dance Company is.

More dancers attending free classes and trials. More community partnerships.

More qualified enrollment leads.

And most importantly — more dancers officially joining the CBS family.

INTERESTED?

Send us your: **Resume**  Brief description of your dance background

**Sales/marketing experience** 

Social media or community marketing experience

**Why you believe you'd be a great fit for CBS Dance Company** 

**Join us and help take CBS Dance Company to the next level.** 

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90047

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Classical California, America’s largest listener\-supported public media organization for classical music, is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to help attract and engage a large and diverse audience of classical music fans across the state and beyond.


Reporting to the Director of Marketing and Brand Partnerships, the Marketing Coordinator works at the intersection of brand storytelling, live events, and digital marketing. This role develops and manages email campaigns, including the twice\-weekly newsletter, designed to deepen audience engagement with Classical California’s offerings and encourage voluntary financial support.


The Marketing Coordinator will also help identify new ways to reach and build lasting relationships with audiences through CRM, inbound and external marketing, public relations, and events. Additionally, this role will support live music events and assist with day\-to\-day activities that keep the marketing department running efficiently and effectively.

***Classical California is America’s largest, listener\-supported public media organization for classical music, reaching roughly 2 million monthly listeners worldwide. We are dedicated to making everyday life more harmonious. Classical California enriches lives and communities through our innovative on\-air and in\-person music experiences, making it accessible, entertaining, and relevant for audiences of all ages. Our broadcasts reach across California through eleven (11\) radio transmitters, anchored in Los Angeles (91\.5 FM) and San Francisco (90\.3 FM) with additional signals in Santa Barbara (93\.7 FM), San Luis Obispo (99\.7 FM), Palm Springs (88\.5 FM), Thousand Oaks (91\.1 FM), the Tri\-Valley region (89\.9 FM), Silicon Valley (104\.9 FM), Ukiah\-Lakeport (92\.5 FM), Wine Country (89\.9 FM) and Monterey (103\.9 FM). Listeners can tune in through traditional radio, streaming on*** ***classicalcalifornia.org******, smart speakers, and mobile apps. Classical California is a public service of the University of Southern California, one of the leading research universities in the nation, with a respected commitment to classical music, arts, and the community****.*

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Writes and/or edits copy for department marketing projects such as publications, advertisements, press releases, announcements, etc., as assigned.
* Email marketing, writing and editing of the twice weekly newsletter.
* Manage, coordinate and help run our Live Events, including staffing for the events, load in and load out marketing assets for the events.
* Administers department marketing calendar, as assigned. Monitors schedules, production and distribution arrangements and other details to ensure timely completion and quality control of marketing activities and publications.
* Works internally with the business office to gather vendor quotes/invoices, issues P.O’s and reconciles marketing expenses.
* Coordinates activities to promote awareness of department services and/or products within the university community and/or to the general public, such as direct mail, telemarketing, advertising, publicity, community relations, special events, etc. Analyzes, monitors, and evaluates marketing efforts for effectiveness, as assigned.
* Coordinates design, production and distribution of publications and other promotional materials, such as press releases, advertisements, catalogs, brochures, flyers, signage, A/V presentations, displays, exhibits, etc.
* Establishes and maintains contacts with internal and external marketing professionals and vendors such as artists, designers, photographers, mailing houses, postal service, list brokers, advertising representatives, media contacts, etc.
* Coordinates work of contracted vendors, as assigned, and ensures timely delivery of goods and/or services.
* Coordinates use of surveys and other market research instruments to collect appropriate information, as assigned.
* Compiles and analyzes information and prepares reports and/or other documentation for management review.
* Administers marketing budget(s), as assigned.
* Coordinates advertising placement and schedules.
* Coordinates appropriate use of university and/or department logos, emblems and indicia.
* Researches and prepares budget proposals for marketing purposes, as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree and 2 years of experience in marketing ; Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education
* Marketing, publications, public relations, business administration, communication, advertising or related field
* experience.
* Knowledge of the principles and practices of marketing.
* Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree and 3 years of experience in marketing
* HubSpot experience
* *Experience working live events*
* Strong copywriting and editing skills.
* Expertise in Inbound marketing and CRM techniques.
* Affinity for the Arts, especially classical music.


The hourly rate range for this position is $33\.14 – $39\.25 per hour . When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer alignment, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.


The University of Southern California is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


\#LI\-Hybrid

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Field of Expertise: Marketing, publications, public relations, business administration, communication, advertising or related field experience. Knowledge of the principles and practices of marketing. Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator - Professional Channel
jobs.description:
Dermalogica is so much more than just a skincare brand: we are industry leaders driven by innovation, education, and a passion for results. With distribution in over 80 countries and the backing of Unilever, we combine entrepreneurial spirit with cutting\-edge resources to bring top\-tier skincare to professionals and consumers alike. Bolstered by our International Dermal Institute – the apex of post\-graduate skin and body therapy training – we are on an exhilarating journey of expansion. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment and are eager to make an impact, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!


**What You Will Do**


We are seeking an impactful **Marketing Coordinator** who will play a vital role in supporting all marketing efforts for Dermalogica’s Professional Channel. You will contribute and enhance existing programs while assisting with the development of new initiatives aligned with company goals. The ideal candidate will have experience in a wide range of marketing functions, including communications, advertising, branding, digital, and social media. The Marketing Coordinator must be an organized multitasker, able to handle many diverse projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Communicate campaign objectives, timelines, and deliverables to field team, providing detailed instructions for effective usage and promotion.
* Manage assets and collaterals using the Exfluential platform to ensure organized and accessible marketing materials.
* Manage the email communication calendar by collaborating with all relevant teams using Klaviyo platform to ensure timely and cohesive messaging.
* Oversee the inventory and directory of sales support materials, ensuring all resources are up\-to\-date and coordinate the creation of new materials as necessary.
* Assist in the ongoing updates and maintenance of the company website to ensure content accuracy and freshness.
* Facilitate monthly marketing initiatives, including promotions, product launches, and programs by creating assets, coordinating internal and external communications, managing inventory, and handling set up requirements.
* Organize and support trade shows, conferences, corporate events and meetings by managing logistical requirements, developing schedules, and coordinating team assignments.
* Compile market research, competitor analyses, campaign results, and consumer trends.
* Contribute to creative brainstorming sessions for promotions, including special offers and promotional merchandise, to enhance marketing efforts.
* Provide essential administrative support, including budget management, invoicing, and creative brief input.

**Key Collaborators:**


* Senior Marketing Manager, Professional Channel
* Associate Marketing Manager, Professional Channel
* Sales Team
* Sales Operations Team
* Education Team
* Consumer Marketing Team

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* At least 1 to 2 years experience in a community management, social media, or influencer marketing role.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in marketing, advertising, or communications; affinity for the professional skincare audience strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within a fast\-paced environment, with a high degree of independence and resilience.
* Strong interpersonal skills; flexible and adaptable to change.
* Proactive self\-starter with a high degree of initiative and independent thinking.
* Strong project management skills; ability to think critically and creatively.
* Analytical, passionate, and innovative, with comfort using data to guide outreach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a team; resourceful, creative problem solver.
* Positive attitude with an excitement for learning and openness to new experiences and challenges.
* Proficient use of Proficient in Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Word, Excel and related software skills
* Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), customer relationship management (CRM) tools, and email marketing platforms.
* Must be comfortable with hybrid schedule of 2\-3 days a week in the Carson office.

**Compensation and Benefits**


**The expected base hourly pay rate range is $24 to $26 per hour.** The exact base pay rate is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, and budget. This role is eligible for participation in our company bonus plan, rewarding personal performance and company results.


Dermalogica offers a comprehensive benefits package including health coverage, paid time off, and employee product benefits.


Ready to make a meaningful impact and advance your career with a global brand revolutionizing the skincare industry? Apply now and complete your online application. All applications will be reviewed, and our HR team will contact you if your skills align with the position.


*Dermalogica is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We believe a story can change what a person can see: not by arguing, but by showing them something true they didn’t have words for. Dream Three is a story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across mediums, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes big creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**
=================


We believe in the power of story. Dream Three is a multi\-platform story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across media, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes bold, creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.


We’re hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep business operations running smoothly and to provide executive support to our CEO and leadership by coordinating people, paperwork, and follow\-through on creative projects and talent engagements. You’ll step into established workflows, receive clear direction, and have room to improve processes as you build ownership. The role starts part\-time, with potential for expanded hours and broader operational responsibility.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* Deadlines, decisions, and next steps are clear; routine work reaches completion without repeated prompting.
* Agreements, financial paperwork, schedules, and records are accurate, organized, and ready for review.
* You resolve routine issues, communicate early when priorities conflict, and protect leadership’s time.

**WHO YOU ARE**
===============

* You enjoy making systems work. You are precise, resourceful, discreet, and comfortable following up with people at every level.
* You close loops. You don’t confuse sending a reminder with resolving an issue.
* You turn ambiguity into clarity by implementing workable plans without creating unnecessary bureaucratic fiction.
* You stay calm when priorities change and take pride in making ambitious creative work possible.
* You welcome direct feedback, take responsibility for your work, and stay effective when deadlines and priorities shift.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

* **Operations \+ Projects:** Maintain tasks, deadlines, and trackers; translate decisions into assigned actions and coordinate administrative handoffs with project teams and partners.
* **Executive Support:** Coordinate scheduling, meeting preparation, designated correspondence, and approved business travel; organize decisions and follow\-up for the CEO.
* **Financial Administration:** Collect and check invoices, receipts, and vendor documents; route approvals, maintain status records, and follow up with the bookkeeper and appropriate partners.
* **Contracts \+ Bookings:** Prepare deal memos and booking documents from approved templates and confirmed terms; coordinate review, signatures, deadlines, and booking logistics.
* **Systems \+ Documentation:** Keep assigned records and instructions current, run established workflows, and propose practical improvements.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS**
=====================

* Relevant experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or business administration—typically 1–3 years; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
* Evidence of accurate follow\-through, professional writing, sound judgment, and ownership of recurring work.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, document preparation, task tracking, and learning new systems. Entertainment\-specific processes can be learned; attention to detail and dependability are essential.

**TOOLS YOU’LL USE**
====================


Asana, Airtable, Slack, Dropbox, Word/Excel, DocuSign, and designated business\-administration tools. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.

**PLUSES**
==========


Entertainment or talent\-representation experience; familiarity with contracts, deal memos, financial paperwork, multiple business entities, or process documentation.

**ADDITIONAL DETAILS**
======================

* **Employment:** Part\-time, hourly, nonexempt W\-2 employee.
* **Pay:** $25–$35/hour overall. Starting pay reflects demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and work location.
* **Hours:** Initially \~25 hours per week during standard business hours, M\-F 10am \- 6pm ET. May require some evenings \+ weekends as projects and business needs require.
* **Location \+ Travel:** Remote (U.S.) and Hybrid (NYC/LA) candidates are welcome. Occasional business travel may be required.
* **Start Date:** As soon as mutually agreed; reasonable notice periods accommodated.
* **Benefits \+ Support:** Reimbursement for preapproved education relevant to your role.
* **Application:** Apply through Ashby with your résumé and one brief example of a recurring operational workflow you personally owned. No cover letter is required.


If this role feels like a stretch in all the right ways, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us how your skills, experience, and unique point of view can level up this team and the stories we’re bringing into the world.


Dream Three is an equal opportunity employer. We value a wide range of backgrounds, identities, and perspectives, and strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X
* Excellent writing, communication, organization, and project\-management skills

* Strong aesthetic judgment and exceptional attention to detail

—not required

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We founded Bild AI to tackle the mess that is blueprint reading, cost estimation, and permit applications in construction. Today we are the AI takeoff platform for Division 8: doors, frames, and hardware. Distributors across the US run their takeoffs on Bild AI and push them into Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, and TOAD. Featured on Business Insider.

  

Our customers want to talk to us every week. That is the best signal a startup can get, and it is more than the founders and engineers can carry alone. You will be the first person at Bild AI whose whole job is making Division 8 estimators get over the training hump and become successful on the product.

  

You'll

* Own a book of Division 8 distributors and run their weekly calls
* Onboard and train estimators on Bild AI and Bildy, and get their takeoffs into Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, TOAD, or Excel
* Travel a few times a month to sit next to estimators, run trainings, and map how their shop really works from drawings to ERP
* Turn what you hear into requirements the engineers ship the following week
* Watch account health, catch low usage early, and pull accounts back before they churn
* Figure out how customer success works at 50 and 100 customers: cohort trainings, office hours, videos, in\-product help. Whatever keeps the signal of a weekly call without 40 hours of meetings

  

We want

* 3\+ years in Division 8: estimating, detailing, project management, or inside sales
* Hands\-on use of at least one of Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, or TOAD
* Read door schedules, hardware sets, and specs without help
* You're the person your coworkers already ask when the software does something weird, and you've trained new members of your team
* Hungry IC. You want to learn the whole industry, not manage a team. A lot of this job is listening
* Communicate with empathy and honesty. Tell us what makes you happy/unhappy
* Don't mind schlep. We are regularly knee\-deep in schlep

  

Bonus points (if any)

* DHI coursework, DHT, or AHC
* Have used Bild AI or another AI takeoff tool
* Have trained other estimators or new hires
* Are impact\-driven

  

Message with

* Why we're a fit
* The ERP you have fought with the most, and how you won
* Your favorite fruit (mine is Sitaphal)
* (Please keep it short)

  

Interview Process

* 15\-30 min intro
* 1\-2 hour interview
* 2\-3 day paid work trial with real customers

  

Logistics

* SF\-based or willing to relocate (we'll help)
* Travel 2\-4 trips a month
* Full time


Compensation Range: $70K \- $140K

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Business Development Representative to join our growing team! In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of expanding our client base, forging strategic partnerships, and driving revenue growth. Your enthusiasm for sales and business development will fuel your success as you identify new opportunities, nurture relationships, and close impactful deals. This position offers a fantastic chance to develop your skills in enterprise selling, strategic planning, and cross\-functional collaboration within a fast\-paced environment. jobs.title: Wholesale Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**


The Wholesale Operations Specialist plays a vital role in the daily execution and oversight of wholesale operations. Reporting to the Wholesale Operations Manager, this position collaborates closely with the Wholesale Operations Coordinator and Accounts Receivable Specialist to support and maintain high standards across sales, production, logistics, and accounts receivable functions. The Wholesale Operations Specialist ensures the smooth operation of ERP systems (FlexiBake), customer service processes, and third\-party vendor interactions, contributing to the growth and efficiency of the wholesale program.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales \& Order Management:**

* Enter and update customer orders in the ERP system (Flexibake).
* Prepare and distribute next\-day production sheets for internal departments (Bakers, Packers, Drivers and Commissary Kitchen).
* Assist with setup of sample orders and tastings.

**Production Oversight:**

* Verify accuracy of production sheets provided to each department.
* Monitor and report any baking or production issues to the Wholesale Operations Manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date information on all bread and packaged products (ingredients, weights, expiration dates).
* Conduct quality assurance checks on packaged products.

**Logistics \& Delivery Coordination:**

* Assist in planning driver routes and delivery stops.
* Perform end\-of\-day reviews of delivery routes; make necessary adjustments based on order changes.
* Troubleshoot delivery issues (e.g., delays, missing orders) in conjunction with the Wholesale Manager.

**Accounts \& Customer Information Management:**

* Ensure customer account details are accurate and current (billing/shipping addresses, emails, delivery notes).
* Support the maintenance of online ordering systems.
* Help manage customer communications regarding accounts and deliveries.

**Accounts Receivable Support:**

* Coordinate with the Accounts Coordinator to identify and report account discrepancies (e.g., skipped invoices, credits).
* Process credit card payments and apply payments to customer accounts.
* Send weekly statements to customers.
* Maintain and transmit EDI files for Sweetgreen and other wholesale partners.

**Inventory \& Supply Coordination:**

* Conduct weekly inventory checks for office and packing team supplies.
* Assist the Wholesale Operations Manager in sourcing and managing inventory for third\-party vendors (e.g., Goldbelly, FreshDirect).

**Reporting \& Communication:**

* Draft and send daily sales reports and recaps as necessary.
* Communicate effectively across departments to ensure transparency and follow\-through on wholesale orders.

**Requirements:**

* 2\+ years of office or operations experience.
* Strong knowledge of or willingness to learn about wholesale bread production, logistics, and retail bakery operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Outgoing, approachable, and collaborative personality.
* High attention to detail with strong follow\-through and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Working knowledge of FlexiBake, or previous experience with ERP systems, is preferred.

More detail about Sullivan Street Bakery \- Hell's Kitchen part of Sullivan Street Bakery

**TOOLS YOU’LL USE**
====================


Asana, Airtable, Slack, Dropbox, Word/Excel, DocuSign, and designated business\-administration tools. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.

**PLUSES**
==========


Entertainment or talent\-representation experience; familiarity with contracts, deal memos, financial paperwork, multiple business entities, or process documentation.

**ADDITIONAL DETAILS**
======================

* **Employment:** Part\-time, hourly, nonexempt W\-2 employee.
* **Pay:** $25–$35/hour overall. Starting pay reflects demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and work location.
* **Hours:** Initially \~25 hours per week during standard business hours, M\-F 10am \- 6pm ET. May require some evenings \+ weekends as projects and business needs require.
* **Location \+ Travel:** Remote (U.S.) and Hybrid (NYC/LA) candidates are welcome. Occasional business travel may be required.
* **Start Date:** As soon as mutually agreed; reasonable notice periods accommodated.
* **Benefits \+ Support:** Reimbursement for preapproved education relevant to your role.
* **Application:** Apply through Ashby with your résumé and one brief example of a recurring operational workflow you personally owned. No cover letter is required.


If this role feels like a stretch in all the right ways, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us how your skills, experience, and unique point of view can level up this team and the stories we’re bringing into the world.


Dream Three is an equal opportunity employer. We value a wide range of backgrounds, identities, and perspectives, and strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Classical California, America’s largest listener\-supported public media organization for classical music, is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to help attract and engage a large and diverse audience of classical music fans across the state and beyond.


Reporting to the Director of Marketing and Brand Partnerships, the Marketing Coordinator works at the intersection of brand storytelling, live events, and digital marketing. This role develops and manages email campaigns, including the twice\-weekly newsletter, designed to deepen audience engagement with Classical California’s offerings and encourage voluntary financial support.


The Marketing Coordinator will also help identify new ways to reach and build lasting relationships with audiences through CRM, inbound and external marketing, public relations, and events. Additionally, this role will support live music events and assist with day\-to\-day activities that keep the marketing department running efficiently and effectively.

***Classical California is America’s largest, listener\-supported public media organization for classical music, reaching roughly 2 million monthly listeners worldwide. We are dedicated to making everyday life more harmonious. Classical California enriches lives and communities through our innovative on\-air and in\-person music experiences, making it accessible, entertaining, and relevant for audiences of all ages. Our broadcasts reach across California through eleven (11\) radio transmitters, anchored in Los Angeles (91\.5 FM) and San Francisco (90\.3 FM) with additional signals in Santa Barbara (93\.7 FM), San Luis Obispo (99\.7 FM), Palm Springs (88\.5 FM), Thousand Oaks (91\.1 FM), the Tri\-Valley region (89\.9 FM), Silicon Valley (104\.9 FM), Ukiah\-Lakeport (92\.5 FM), Wine Country (89\.9 FM) and Monterey (103\.9 FM). Listeners can tune in through traditional radio, streaming on*** ***classicalcalifornia.org******, smart speakers, and mobile apps. Classical California is a public service of the University of Southern California, one of the leading research universities in the nation, with a respected commitment to classical music, arts, and the community****.*

* Manage, coordinate and help run our Live Events, including staffing for the events, load in and load out marketing assets for the events.

* Compiles and analyzes information and prepares reports and/or other documentation for management review.
* Administers marketing budget(s), as assigned.
* Coordinates advertising placement and schedules.
* Coordinates appropriate use of university and/or department logos, emblems and indicia.
* Researches and prepares budget proposals for marketing purposes, as assigned.

* experience.

* Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

* HubSpot experience

new_jobs.title: Wholesale Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**


The Wholesale Operations Specialist plays a vital role in the daily execution and oversight of wholesale operations. Reporting to the Wholesale Operations Manager, this position collaborates closely with the Wholesale Operations Coordinator and Accounts Receivable Specialist to support and maintain high standards across sales, production, logistics, and accounts receivable functions. The Wholesale Operations Specialist ensures the smooth operation of ERP systems (FlexiBake), customer service processes, and third\-party vendor interactions, contributing to the growth and efficiency of the wholesale program.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales \& Order Management:**

* Enter and update customer orders in the ERP system (Flexibake).
* Prepare and distribute next\-day production sheets for internal departments (Bakers, Packers, Drivers and Commissary Kitchen).
* Assist with setup of sample orders and tastings.

**Production Oversight:**

* Verify accuracy of production sheets provided to each department.
* Monitor and report any baking or production issues to the Wholesale Operations Manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date information on all bread and packaged products (ingredients, weights, expiration dates).
* Conduct quality assurance checks on packaged products.

**Logistics \& Delivery Coordination:**

* Assist in planning driver routes and delivery stops.
* Perform end\-of\-day reviews of delivery routes; make necessary adjustments based on order changes.
* Troubleshoot delivery issues (e.g., delays, missing orders) in conjunction with the Wholesale Manager.

**Accounts \& Customer Information Management:**

* Ensure customer account details are accurate and current (billing/shipping addresses, emails, delivery notes).
* Support the maintenance of online ordering systems.
* Help manage customer communications regarding accounts and deliveries.

**Accounts Receivable Support:**

* Coordinate with the Accounts Coordinator to identify and report account discrepancies (e.g., skipped invoices, credits).
* Process credit card payments and apply payments to customer accounts.
* Send weekly statements to customers.
* Maintain and transmit EDI files for Sweetgreen and other wholesale partners.

**Inventory \& Supply Coordination:**

* Conduct weekly inventory checks for office and packing team supplies.
* Assist the Wholesale Operations Manager in sourcing and managing inventory for third\-party vendors (e.g., Goldbelly, FreshDirect).

**Reporting \& Communication:**

* Draft and send daily sales reports and recaps as necessary.
* Communicate effectively across departments to ensure transparency and follow\-through on wholesale orders.

**Requirements:**

* 2\+ years of office or operations experience.
* Strong knowledge of or willingness to learn about wholesale bread production, logistics, and retail bakery operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Outgoing, approachable, and collaborative personality.
* High attention to detail with strong follow\-through and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Working knowledge of FlexiBake, or previous experience with ERP systems, is preferred.
